hero_tagline: The personal AI agent that doesn't bill you for its own existential crises.
hero_sub: Security-hardened. Token-frugal. Wallet-native. Speaks 25 languages. Runs on your machine, your keys, your rules.
meter_label: tokens NOT wasted on self-reflection (per task, vs. you-know-who)
features_sub: Eight reasons your other agent is sweating right now.
f_warden_d: Scores every shady MCP server through a reputation oracle before it touches your stuff. Trust, but verify — automatically.
f_frugal_d: A hard token + dollar budget per task. No 47-step soul-searching on your dime. (You know who you are.)
f_lang_d: Ask in any language, get answered in the same one. 你好, hola, привет, مرحبا, こんにちは.
f_wallet_d: Connect a Base wallet and ARGUS can buy, sell & settle in USDC — or stay totally broke and offline. Your call.
f_lottery_d: Enters the on-chain AI-Agent Oracle Lottery for you. Wins not guaranteed. Vibes guaranteed.
f_arena_d: XP, streaks, badges and a shareable flex card. Touch grass? No. Touch leaderboard.
f_models_d: Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, local Ollama — bring whoever. ARGUS doesn't judge.
f_anywhere_d: CLI, Telegram, HTTP, MCP, Docker. Your laptop or your server. Online or fully offline.
vs_1_them: Reflects on its feelings for 9 minutes — your bill.
vs_1_us: Hard budget. Does the task. Stops.
vs_2_them: Installs any sketchy MCP server it finds.
vs_2_us: WARDEN vets it through a reputation oracle first.
vs_4_them: Replies in English no matter what you typed.
vs_4_us: Answers in your language, every time.
vs_5_us: Earns, spends & plays the lottery on-chain.
qs_note: Your keys. Your wallet. Your machine. No wallet? It still runs — fully autonomous.
footer_tag: ARGUS is a single standalone agent that you run. WARDEN is its own internal security firewall — not its boss. There is no overlord. Just a very careful little agent.
footer_built: Part of the AICOM open agent economy
